issue_context.title: [BUG] Box step not works with expect.soft
issue_context.body:
### System info
- Playwright Version: [v1.39]
- Operating System: [Windows 11]
- Browser: [Chromium]
- Other info:

### Source code

So I added {box: true} in POM and it works perfect if I use expect alone, the error will directly point to my spec file. However, if I add expect.soft in the method then it will point out the error in the POM file not spec anymore.
w/o soft: 
![image](https://github.com/microsoft/playwright/assets/71114633/fdac3d30-b5a2-4671-b3c6-829d253a3b1b)
with soft: 
![image](https://github.com/microsoft/playwright/assets/71114633/4934a8df-0fd4-404b-9997-6d43f2a515e2)

**Steps**
- Used box step with method in POM
- Add expect.soft
- Run the test with invalid value to fail

**Expected**

The error should be shown in spec file

**Actual**

When add expect.soft to the POM method the error will be shown in POM file not spec even if option box = true

review_comments: So it looks like we actually do change the stack at runtime? Perhaps we should avoid modifying the error?
Yes, I'll try to follow up with the fix.
